title: Combustible piping in a drain, waste and vent system
jurisdiction: British Columbia (specific local authority not named in published decision)

facts.text: A high-rise multi-unit residential building has mostly non-combustible DWV piping that penetrates rated horizontal and vertical separations. Combustible p-traps and trap arms are proposed within unrated suite partition walls for sinks and clothes washers.
The local authority raised concern that failure or lack of firestopping could create conduits between fire compartments; the appellant sought permission for the combustible transitions.
